# Operations table

Every transport sends a request document through `dispatch`, which looks the operation up in
`OPERATIONS`, checks the caller's right, decodes the request, calls the `LocalApplication` method
of the same name and encodes the response. The request and response schemas are in the
repository's `schemas/` directory.

| Operation | Right | Transports | HTTP | MCP tool |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `validate` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `POST /v1/revisions/{revision_id}/validate` | `validate_revision` |
| `commit_change` | draft | python, cli, http, mcp | `POST /v1/changes` | `commit_change` |
| `solve` | execute | python, cli | — | — |
| `reproduce` | execute | python, cli | — | — |
| `submit_job` | execute | python, cli, http, mcp | `POST /v1/jobs` | `submit_job` |
| `get_job` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` | `get_job` |
| `list_jobs` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/jobs` | `list_jobs` |
| `list_job_events` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/events` | `list_job_events` |
| `wait_job` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/wait` | `wait_job` |
| `cancel_job` | execute | python, cli, http, mcp | `POST /v1/jobs/{job_id}/cancel` | `cancel_job` |
| `get_job_result` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/result` | `get_job_result` |
| `get_project` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/project` | `get_project` |
| `list_models` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/models` | `list_models` |
| `list_revisions` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/revisions` | `list_revisions` |
| `get_revision` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/revisions/{revision_id}` | `get_revision` |
| `diff_revisions` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/revisions/{from_revision}/diff/{to_revision}` | `diff_revisions` |
| `inspect_structure` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/revisions/{revision_id}/structure` | `inspect_structure` |
| `preview_change` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `POST /v1/changes/preview` | `preview_change` |
| `get_artifact` | read | python, cli, http, mcp | `GET /v1/artifacts/{artifact_id}` | `get_artifact` |
| `list_audit` | read | python, cli, http | `GET /v1/audit` | — |
| `artifact_bytes` | read | python, cli, http | `GET /v1/artifacts/{artifact_id}/raw` | — |
